get.description: Public client bootstrap info: minimum app versions and server capabilities.

post.description: Create an account and sign in. A verification code is emailed immediately.
Sign in (or sign up) with an Apple or Google ID token obtained on the device.

Exchange the current refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once.

Clients must run refreshes one at a time and always store the newest refresh token.
Re-using an old token signs the device out (it indicates the token was copied).
Sign out this device.
Sign out every device, including this one.

get.description: Devices currently signed in to this account.

post.description: Always returns 202, whether or not the email has an account.
Set a new password with the emailed code. Signs out every device.
Change password. This device stays signed in; all others are signed out.

put.description: Register or refresh this installation's Expo push token. Safe to call on every app start.

post.description: Deactivate the account now and permanently delete it after the grace period.

patch.description: Update profile fields (JSON). Images use the dedicated upload endpoints.

get.description: People you follow or who follow you (for "Send to"), optionally filtered by name.

post.description: Block a user: removes follows both ways and hides each of you from the other.
Hide a user's posts from your feeds without them knowing.

Create a post: text, up to MAX_POST_IMAGES photos (`uploads`, or the older single `upload`),
and optionally a Lift (a request for prayer or support).

get.description:
Chronological home feed: the viewer's own posts, posts from people they follow, posts on Pages they
follow or belong to, and announcements addressed to them (minus muted people).

A person's own posts for their profile: only what the viewer is allowed to see, newest first.

Page and group posts stay on their Page/group; blocked users are 'not found'.

post.description: Flag a post for review. Reporting the same post again updates the earlier report.

get.description: Comments oldest-first (conversation order), cursor-paginated.
Bookmarked posts the viewer can still see (deleted or now-private posts drop out).

Public posts from people the viewer doesn't follow, newest first.

Deliberately simple until ranking is designed (see roadmap §8A): sorting by a
live reaction COUNT across all posts doesn't scale and isn't explainable.

post.description: Answer a Lift with "I'll pray" or "I'm with you". Answering again changes your answer.

get.description: Who is praying for / standing with this person, newest first.

post.description: The author shares how things are going, or a testimony. Everyone who answered is told.

get.description:
Lifts the viewer can see, from everyone (not just people they follow), newest first.

`answered=true` lists testimonies instead.

post.description:
Repost a post to your followers, optionally with your own words (a quote).

Reposting a repost shares the original. A plain repost happens once per post (repeating it
returns the existing one). Only posts everyone can already see can be reposted.

delete.description: Undo your plain repost of this post (quote reposts are deleted like any other post).

post.description:
Send a post to up to 10 people on Vine. They get a notification that opens the post.

Only to people you follow or who follow you (keeps it from being used to spam or target
strangers), only if they're allowed to see the post, and never across a block.

get.description: Types a user can pick when creating a Page, with what each one offers.
Pages the viewer belongs to (or asked to join), helps run, and follows.

post.description: Join: approved at once when the Page is open, otherwise a request (status 'pending').

delete.description: Leave the Page, or withdraw a pending request.

patch.description: Approve/ban members and change their legacy role (admin/moderator). Rules: `services.moderate_member`.

delete.description: Decline a join request or remove a member. Rules: `services.remove_member`.

get.description: Members are visible to the Page's members and managers only: belonging to a church is personal.

Posts published to this Page that the viewer may see (public posts, members-only posts for members),
plus announcements its organization addressed to this Page.

post.description: Send an announcement. Without `audience` it goes to this Page's own members (as before).

get.description: Announcements on this Page that the viewer is in the audience for (pinned first).
The viewer's roles and permissions on this Page, so the app shows only the controls they may use.
The organization this Page belongs to: its HQ and branches. Null for a standalone Page (no hierarchy UI).

post.description: HQ invites an existing Page to become one of its branches; that Page's owner accepts or declines.
This Page's owner asks to join an HQ as a branch; the HQ approves or declines.
Ask to move your home to this Page (another branch or the HQ of your organization).

get.description: Pending moves into this Page, for people who manage its members.

post.description: Schedule a live service on a Page. The app then fetches ingest details for the encoder.

get.description: A Page's services, plus its HQ's (a branch shows the HQ's services too).
RTMPS URL and stream key for the encoder. Managers only; every view is audited.

post.description: REST fallback for clients without a WebSocket; the message is broadcast the same way.
Mute someone in chat on this Page for a while (moderators: volunteers and Page leadership).

get.description: The care team sees every request; everyone else sees requests shared with the room, and their own.

post.description: A single-use ticket (30 s) for opening a WebSocket: wss://<realtime host>/ws/live/<room id>/?ticket=...
Cloudflare Notifications "Stream Live Input" events: live_input.connected / live_input.disconnected.
Cloudflare Stream video webhooks (signed): a recording finished processing -> the replay.

get.description: Who the viewer can give to from this Page: their home branch first, one tap to the HQ or another branch.

post.description: Start a gift. Returns what the app's payment sheet needs; the gift completes when the provider confirms it.

get.description: Year-end giving statements, one per church entity given to (for tax purposes).

post.description: A link to the provider's onboarding (identity, bank account). Creates the payout account the first time.
A branch asks to receive gifts through its HQ's payout account (same legal entity).

get.description: Totals by fund, or by branch for an HQ. Never individual gifts; tiny buckets are hidden.
Individual gifts: this Page's finance admins only. Every view is audited.

post.description: Stripe Connect events (connected accounts). Verified by signature; each event is applied once.
